reuse.why: Adds a new category_groups.notes column via migration although the tree stores notes in the notes table keyed by id, and detects #fixed with its own case-insensitive regex instead of the shared extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: The category-selection SQL (hidden/includeHidden/goal_def/group notes) is pasted into setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg, and each loop repeats the isFixedGroup and income-outside-tracking checks, with copyPreviousMonth carrying a third variant in JS.

placement.why: Exclusion rules are spread across each action's SQL and loop rather than one selection function, and group notes are moved into a new schema column outside the existing notes layer.

scope.why: Edits serve the four steps, but a schema migration and DbCategoryGroup type change are out of proportion to reading an existing note.

maintainability.why: Every future change to which categories a month-wide action fills must be made in six places, and #fixed notes now live in a second storage location that the notes UI does not write.

bypasses_abstraction.where: migrations/1791816749591_add_category_group_notes.sql and isFixedGroup in server/budget/actions.ts bypass the notes table and shared/tags extractTagsFromText

disguised_duplication.where: setZero's selection is a reshaped variant of the averaging query (COALESCE(g.hidden,0), DbCategory typing) and copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the same rules as a JS condition over getBudgetData rows

abstraction_drift.where: No shared selection helper is introduced; copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg and set12MonthAvg each implement the hidden/template/#fixed/income selection and each gains its own includeHiddenCategories parameter
